_comment: App Store Connect settings that tools/asc_store.py applies (GitHub: Actions > Night Precinct store listing). The store text itself comes from appstore/metadata/en-US/*.txt, filled in from release.config.json. Territory codes are Apple's three-letter codes. Reasons for each excluded country: appstore/COMPLIANCE_BY_COUNTRY.md. tools/asc_iap.py uses the same list for the in-app purchases.

age_rating._comment: Answers and reasons: appstore/AGE_RATING.md. Loot boxes = yes sets 9+ (16+ in Australia). Contests, cartoon violence and weapons are answered Infrequent, the cautious reading of Apple's definitions (personal goals with rewards; chasing and cuffing crooks; weapon-like upgrade names such as Taser X2); Apple's table puts each of those at 9+ or lower, so the rating stays 9+.
